items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: Matter of fact my mother told me this. And he told her, call her Rose, don't call her mother, you know.

ctx.x: What do you think about that?

Well he, he, well he brought that on itself because see, from what I understand how that happened when my oldest sister was born. She was a little baby and just began to learn to talk. Matter of fact my mother told me this. And he told her, call her Rose, don't call her mother, you know. And she said look if you call me Rose, say I'm a whipping, you see, now you call him Nick. And so she started calling him Nick. And so all that's born after.
